text: 股市资金流向图：今日沪深两市主力资金净流出165.31亿元，占比1.01%；大单资金净流出91.45亿元，占比0.56%；小单资金净流入175.88亿元，占比1.08%
text_en: Stock market fund flow chart: Today, net outflow of main funds in Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was 16.531 billion yuan, accounting for 1.01%; net outflow of large-order funds was 9.145 billion yuan, accounting for 0.56%; net inflow of small-order funds was 17.588 billion yuan, accounting for 1.08%
